models.description: Binary person/background segmentation for portrait background blur, background replacement and subject cutout. Outputs one float32 person-confidence mask. Smallest verified MediaPipe segmenter and the recommended default BUNDLED model for the MVP (249,537 bytes, under the 5 MB bundle budget).

inputSpec.source: Tensor shapes/dtype read from the .tflite flatbuffer (input 'input_1') on 2026-11-16; NormalizationOptions mean=[0.0] std=[255.0] embedded in TFLite metadata, applied by MediaPipe image_preprocessing_graph.cc as (0-mean)/std .. (255-mean)/std; model card: 'Channels order: RGB with values in [0.0, 1.0]'.

outputSpec.activation: NONE (no post-activation applied by MediaPipe; graph output is already person confidence)
outputSpec.maskSemantics: float32 confidence in [0.0, 1.0]; MediaPipe derives the uint8 category mask as person > 0.5 -> 1 else 0 (background).
outputSpec.source: Tensor shape/dtype read from the .tflite flatbuffer (output 'activation_10'); activation read from embedded SEGMENTER_METADATA custom metadata (field absent = schema default NONE); confidence range [0.0,1.0] per model card and https://ai.google.dev/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/image_segmenter; 0.5 binary threshold per MediaPipe tensors_to_segmentation_calculator.cc.

Model distributed by Google as part of MediaPipe. Model card: https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-assets/Model%20Card%20MediaPipe%20Selfie%20Segmentation.pdf

verification.method: downloaded from sourceUrl; SHA-256 via Get-FileHash; 'latest' alias confirmed byte-identical (same size + ETag 3b2e3e1cfc7d31538caf00ff4e0fba8c)

models.notes: Model card describes this as the 249 KB general/squat model; intended for human segmentation in AR / video-conferencing. Preprocessing/resizing is automatic when using the MediaPipe ImageSegmenter API; if implementing raw TFLite, replicate inputSpec exactly.

models.description: Landscape-input (H=144, W=256) variant of the selfie segmenter; same person/background binary mask. Optional BUNDLED extra for camera/video-call-style UI where the frame is always landscape.

inputSpec.source: Tensor shapes/dtype read from the .tflite flatbuffer (input 'input_1') on 2026-11-16; NormalizationOptions mean=[0.0] std=[255.0] in embedded TFLite metadata; model card: landscape model is a 144 x 256 x 3 tensor, RGB in [0.0, 1.0].

outputSpec.activation: NONE (no post-activation; graph output is already person confidence)
outputSpec.maskSemantics: float32 confidence in [0.0, 1.0]; category mask = person > 0.5.
outputSpec.source: Tensor shape/dtype read from the .tflite flatbuffer (output 'segment_back'); activation from embedded SEGMENTER_METADATA (absent = NONE); threshold logic per MediaPipe tensors_to_segmentation_calculator.cc.

models.attribution: "MediaPipe Selfie Segmentation" model card (landscape variant), Tingbo Hou, Siargey Pisarchyk, Karthik Raveendran (Google), May 6, 2021, licensed under Apache License, Version 2.0.

verification.method: downloaded from sourceUrl; SHA-256 via Get-FileHash; 'latest' alias byte-identical (ETag 880c84cde97f80aa20d1b09d09c20113)

models.notes: Optional. Only one bundled segmenter is required for MVP; adding both square and landscape costs ~500 KB total.

models.description: Higher-quality 6-class portrait segmentation (background, hair, body-skin, face-skin, clothes, accessories) for cleaner subject cutout and hair-aware background effects. Recommended DOWNLOAD-at-runtime upgrade over the bundled binary segmenter; same MediaPipe ImageSegmenter runtime, no extra native dependency.

inputSpec.resizePolicy: stretch to 256x256 (keep_aspect_ratio=false, no letterbox); model card notes the input need not be pre-resized, portrait/landscape accepted
inputSpec.source: Tensor shapes/dtype read from the .tflite flatbuffer (input 'input_29') on 2026-11-16; NormalizationOptions mean=[127.5] std=[127.5] in embedded TFLite metadata; model card: 'normalized RGB image, at resolution of [256, 256, 3]'.

outputSpec.activation: SOFTMAX — raw TFLite output is PRE-activation logits; the app must apply softmax across the channel axis after inference (MediaPipe applies it outside the model; direct LiteRT/TFLite integration must replicate this).
outputSpec.maskSemantics: float32 per-class confidence masks in [0.0, 1.0] (6 separate masks); category mask = argmax over the 6 channels. No single global threshold is defined by the model.
outputSpec.source: Tensor shape/dtype read from the .tflite flatbuffer (output 'Identity'); activation=SOFTMAX read from embedded SEGMENTER_METADATA custom metadata; class order from https://ai.google.dev/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/image_segmenter; confidence range per docs ('per-category floating-point confidence masks in [0.0, 1.0]').

verification.method: downloaded from sourceUrl; SHA-256 via Get-FileHash; 'latest' alias byte-identical (ETag 6ca6a40d84bcb910420a1a43a295100a)

models.notes: 16.37 MB download. Google's Pixel 6 benchmark: 71.24 ms GPU / 217.76 ms CPU per frame (docs page, task benchmarks). Download only over unmetered/Wi-Fi by default; verify SHA-256 after download and before use; store in app-private storage.

models.description: Optional 2-class hair/background segmentation for hair recoloring or hair-aware blur. DOWNLOAD at runtime (781,618 bytes). Uses MediaPipe's 4-channel legacy preprocessing path (RGBA input with alpha forced to 0).

inputSpec.normalization: (pixel - 0.0) / 255.0 -> [0.0, 1.0] for RGB channels; alpha channel is forced to 0 by MediaPipe
inputSpec.source: Tensor shape/dtype read from the .tflite flatbuffer (input 'input_1', 4 channels) on 2026-11-16; NormalizationOptions mean=[0.0] std=[255.0] in embedded TFLite metadata; MediaPipe image_segmenter_graph.cc special-cases 4-channel inputs and applies SetAlphaCalculator(alpha=0) before TensorConverterCalculator.

outputSpec.activation: SOFTMAX — raw TFLite output is PRE-activation logits; the app must apply softmax across the channel axis after inference (MediaPipe applies it outside the model; direct LiteRT/TFLite integration must replicate this).
outputSpec.maskSemantics: float32 probabilities in [0.0, 1.0] for background and hair; category mask = argmax (0=background, 1=hair) per docs table.
outputSpec.source: Tensor shape/dtype read from the .tflite flatbuffer (output 'conv2d_transpose_4'); activation=SOFTMAX from embedded SEGMENTER_METADATA; class labels from https://ai.google.dev/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/image_segmenter.

verification.method: downloaded from sourceUrl; SHA-256 via Get-FileHash; 'latest' alias byte-identical (ETag 1effac57961bd80e59011dc99bd00cc1)

models.notes: Optional; not required for MVP background removal. 512x512 input/output is heavier than the selfie models (Pixel 6 benchmark 52.14 ms GPU / 57.90 ms CPU). Only meaningful for single-person selfies.

models.description: General-purpose 21-class segmentation for objects, pets, products, scenery and people. Best when the subject is not a portrait. A 2.8 MB download that complements the portrait models.

inputSpec.source: Tensor shapes/dtype read from the .tflite flatbuffer (input sub_7) on 2026-11-22; graph uses only builtin ADD/AVERAGE_POOL_2D/CONCATENATION/CONV_2D/DEPTHWISE_CONV_2D/RESIZE_BILINEAR ops. Normalization mean=[127.5], std=[127.5] per the litert-community DeepLab-V3 model card / MediaPipe image-preprocessing default; not independently execution-verified.

outputSpec.activation: SOFTMAX — raw TFLite output is PRE-activation logits; the app must apply softmax across the 21-channel axis after inference (verified: no SOFTMAX/LOGISTIC op in the 70-op graph; ai-edge-litert 2.4.0 run on random input returned logits from -3.91 to 17.98, 99.5% of values outside [0,1]).
outputSpec.maskSemantics: float32 per-class logits; after softmax, alpha = 1 - P(background) = sum of the 20 foreground class probabilities. No single global threshold is defined by the model.
outputSpec.source: Tensor shape/dtype read from the .tflite flatbuffer (output ResizeBilinear_3); class order extracted from labels.txt/labelmap.txt embedded in TFLITE_METADATA associated files.

verification.method: downloaded from sourceUrl; SHA-256 via Get-FileHash; HEAD on GCS /1/ and /latest/ both 200, Content-Length 2,780,176, ETag 89cbf585278bae20ce7606c07d7071dd; HF mirror LFS sha256 equals local hash; tensors read from flatbuffer; logits behavior confirmed by ai-edge-litert 2.4.0 inference.

models.notes: 2.78 MB DOWNLOAD. Google Pixel 6 benchmark: 123.93 ms CPU / 103.30 ms GPU (MediaPipe docs task benchmarks). Optional BUNDLED variant if the 5 MB APK bundle budget allows. Model uses only standard builtin ops (no Flex/custom), so it loads on the app TFLite 2.3.2 runtime. Not a portrait matte: it returns 21-class logits, so the app alpha is the summed foreground probability (threshold null).

models.description: Soft portrait alpha matting with hair and edge detail, for cleaner cut-outs than a binary mask. A 25 MB download; best for people, not general objects.

inputSpec.source: Tensor shapes/dtype read from the .tflite flatbuffer (input serving_default_args_0) on 2026-11-22; NCHW RGB preprocessing and [0,1] soft-alpha output per the litert-community/MODNet-LiteRT model card; upstream MODNet is Apache-2.0.

outputSpec.activation: NONE — graph ends with LOGISTIC; the raw output is already alpha in [0.0, 1.0].
outputSpec.maskSemantics: float32 soft alpha in [0.0, 1.0] for the portrait subject; no background class is needed (single-channel matte).
outputSpec.source: Tensor shape/dtype read from the .tflite flatbuffer (output serving_default_output_0_output) on 2026-11-22; graph tail includes LOGISTIC and RESHAPE, so the app must not apply another activation.

models.attribution: MODNet: Real-Time Trimap-Free Portrait Matting via Objective Decomposition, Zhanghan Ke, Jiayu Sun, Kaican Li, Qiong Yan, Rynson W.H. Lau (AAAI 2022), Apache License 2.0. Upstream: https://github.com/ZHKKKe/MODNet ; LiteRT conversion: https://huggingface.co/litert-community/MODNet-LiteRT

verification.method: downloaded from downloadUrl; SHA-256 via Get-FileHash matches the Hugging Face LFS oid; tensor shapes/dtype read from the .tflite flatbuffer; graph tail inspected (LOGISTIC/RESHAPE). License evidence: upstream GitHub repository Apache-2.0 and the HF model card tag.

models.notes: 26.17 MB DOWNLOAD. Upstream MODNet benchmark: about 419 ms CPU (4 threads) / 79 ms GPU per 512x512 frame; first inference also pays model-load time. This is a portrait matte, not a general object segmenter; use DeepLab-V3 for pets/products. The app's NCHW path writes RGB channel planes and reads the single-channel planar output as-is.
